title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-20 12:35:33 最新章节：第14章 无声的争夺
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
“同学，醒醒，马上要到站了。”
迷迷糊糊之间，李司伦感觉有一个声音在耳边回响，好像是在叫自己。
“嗯……”
他发出一声低吟，试图让自己清醒过来。
“到站？我不是才刚上车吗？”
李司伦心里闪过一丝疑惑，他记得自己刚刚上的火车，怎么这么快就要到站了呢？而且自己是什么时候睡着的，怎么一点印象都没有。
他努力想要睁开眼睛，可眼皮就像是被胶水黏住了似的，怎么也撑不开。
“唔……好困……眼皮怎么这么重？”
李司伦喃喃自语道，脑袋里一片混沌。
他试图回忆起自己上车后的情景，但脑海中的记忆仿佛被一层迷雾笼罩着，模糊不清。
反倒是发现脑子里多了许多本不属于李司伦的记忆。
是法伦特里斯的记忆。
各种记忆交杂在一起，每当李司伦想要回想起什么的时候，记忆却在不断刺痛着李司伦的神经。
李司伦不由地抱住脑袋。
我是谁？我是李司伦吗？
还是……法伦?特里斯？
“我还是第一次见灵视的反应居然会这么强烈。”
李司伦听出来了是刚刚的声音，并且很明显可以听出是女孩子的声音。
这家伙说的是什么方言吗？为什么我也能听得懂？李司伦一闪而过的疑问。
“我可以帮你清除灵视带来的污染，但是你得欠我个人情知道吗？”

见李司伦没有反应，女生有点没好气地说道，“就是可以当你现在舒服一点，答应就点点头，或者晃晃脑袋也行。”
此刻的李司伦只觉得自己的脑袋仿佛被人搅拌成了一团浆糊，完全失去了思考能力。
面对这个要求，他只能机械地晃了晃脑袋，表示同意。
毕竟，此时此刻，他最迫切的愿望就是让这该死的头痛停止。
然而，就在他晃动脑袋的瞬间，一股清凉的感觉突然袭来，像是一滴滴水落入平静的湖面，迅速扩散开来。
紧接着，一种难以言喻的舒适感涌上心头，仿佛整个人都被一股温暖的力量包裹着。
原本头疼欲裂的感觉瞬间消失得无影无踪，那台在脑海中疯狂运转、搅动的搅拌机也似乎戛然而止。
一切都变得安静下来，只有那清脆的滴水声在耳边回响。
这时一个不合时宜的机械音在脑袋里响起，
【检测到宿主脱离混乱状态，有意义的高中生生活系统自行激活，现已开放五维系统，希望宿主能在接下来的高中生生活中努力提高自己的五维属性，度过一个有意义的高中生涯，成为一个对社会有用的人才。
【什么鬼东西？有人在我脑袋里说话？】虽然李司伦完全没搞明白现在是什么状况，但似乎眼睛可以睁开了。
“我刚买的召唤符啊……”
content_en:
"Classmate, wake up, we are almost at the station."
Drowsily, Li Silun felt a voice echoing in his ears, as if calling him.
"Well..."
He let out a low groan, trying to wake himself up.
"Arrived? Didn't I just get on the bus?"
A trace of doubt flashed in Li Silun's mind. He remembered the train he had just boarded. Why was it arriving at the station so soon? And I have no memory of when I fell asleep.
He tried hard to open his eyes, but his eyelids seemed to be stuck with glue and he couldn't open them.
"Hmm...so sleepy...why are your eyelids so heavy?"
Li Silun muttered to himself, his head in chaos.
He tried to recall the scene after he got in the car, but the memory in his mind seemed to be shrouded in a layer of fog and blurred.
On the contrary, I found that there were many more memories in my mind that did not belong to Li Silun.
It's the memory of Farentris.
Various memories are mixed together. Whenever Li Silun wants to recall something, the memory keeps hurting Li Silun's nerves.
Li Silun couldn't help but hold his head.
who I am? Am I Li Silun?
Or... Fallon Tris?
"This is the first time I've had such a strong reaction after seeing a spiritual vision."
Li Silun recognized the voice just now, and it was obvious that it was a girl's voice.
What dialect does this guy speak? Why can I understand it too? Li Silun had a fleeting question.
"I can help you remove the pollution caused by your spiritual vision, but you have to owe me a favor, you know?"
Seeing that Li Silun didn't respond, the girl said angrily, "You can just pretend that you feel more comfortable now and just nod your head or shake your head if you agree."
At this moment, Li Silun felt as if his head had been stirred into a ball of paste, and he had completely lost the ability to think.
Faced with this request, he could only mechanically shake his head in agreement.
After all, at this moment, his most urgent wish was to make this damn headache stop.
However, the moment he shook his head, a cool feeling suddenly hit him, like a drop of water falling into a calm lake, spreading quickly.
Immediately afterwards, an indescribable feeling of comfort came to my heart, as if my whole body was wrapped in a warm force.
The splitting headache that I had originally felt disappeared without a trace in an instant, and the blender that was running and churning crazily in my mind seemed to have stopped abruptly.
Everything became quiet, only the crisp sound of dripping water echoed in my ears.
At this moment, an inappropriate mechanical sound sounded in my head,
[It is detected that the host is out of the chaotic state, and the meaningful high school student life system is automatically activated. The five-dimensional system is now open. I hope that the host can work hard to improve its five-dimensional attributes in the next high school student life, spend a meaningful high school career, and become a useful talent to society.
【What the hell? Someone talking in my head? 】Although Li Silun didn't understand what was going on at all, it seemed that he could open his eyes.
"The summoning talisman I just bought..."
